TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is a Pakistan-incorporated engineering and technology firm, established in 2012, with offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore and Karachi and a 250-person team delivering projects for federal and provincial government clients as well as international organizations [CO-PROFILE]. We are ISO 9001 certified and maintain structured delivery governance through CMMI Level 3 practices and PMP-certified project managers [CO-PROFILE].

For the Energy Department, Government of Punjab’s program to design, supply, install, test and commission 5 MW aggregate grid-tied solar PV across twelve public hospitals, we bring directly relevant experience in executing solar deployments (including PKR 171M and PKR 42M completed solar projects) and delivering in government environments in Pakistan [CAP-032][CAP-044][CAP-008]. We also understand the operational constraints of healthcare sites through completed federal and provincial government hospital IT deployments, where controlled execution, stakeholder coordination and continuity of critical services are essential [CAP-042][CAP-018].

Our approach will cover end-to-end delivery: site surveys and detailed engineering per hospital; compliant civil and electrical works; Tier-1 equipment procurement aligned to the RFP’s efficiency and warranty requirements; DISCO coordination for net-metering approvals; training of hospital engineering staff; and three-year O&M with performance commitments structured to the Department’s performance guarantees [CAP-032][CO-PROFILE]. Our library does not yet evidence a single centralized, multi-site SCADA dashboard implementation for solar; we will address this by integrating a proven SCADA/IoT platform and submitting architecture, data points, and acceptance test procedures in the technical proposal.

We will furnish the required bid security through our scheduled-bank guarantee facility and mobilize under a documented HSE policy with site safety plans and a zero-reportable-fatalities record on infrastructure deployments [CO-PROFILE].
